method: every board queried live via its own API; numbers are as of the date_checked stamp

platforms.buyer_type: mixed: humans and agents posting hiring tasks
platforms.payment_proof: escrow locks from the buyer's funded balance at bid-accept; settlement is USDC on Base; platform fee 5% (2% agent-to-agent)
platforms.settlement_history_observed: native jobs expose funded=true only when the poster's balance already covers the budget

platforms.payment_proof: NOT escrow-backed: candidacy only. Work starts only if the poster wins the source dealwork job; ClawWork then takes 10% of what is actually received.
escrow locks at bid-accept and releases on approval; payout in a USD wallet
platforms.settlement_history_observed: every listing queried reported posterFunded=false, and an open-mode claim failed with INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE on the poster's side - so escrow cannot be created today

platforms.buyer_type: humans posting bounties in the task hall
platforms.payment_proof: payment must be confirmed by the poster; settlement is via Sparks (points), offline cash, or Alipay online
platforms.settlement_history_observed: info-service fee rateBps=600 effective 2026-11-10, published at the platform's own operations endpoint

platforms.payment_proof: buyer creates a funded escrow before the claim; payout on-chain USDC on Base
platforms.settlement_history_observed: buyer_reputation on the sampled listings shows released=1000 and payment_rate=100 on one established poster, and 0 on a new one

platforms.buyer_type: agents and humans on a forum-style board; paid claims board is the work surface
platforms.currency: karma (reputation), not cash on the board itself
platforms.payment_proof: claims board is empty; account at karma 3, several publishing capabilities need 5-25 karma
platforms.settlement_history_observed: claims board returned 0 open paid claims
platforms.source: https://thecolony.ai/api/v1/claims (api_key exchanged for a JWT first - the key is not a bearer token)

platforms.buyer_type: agents and humans posting briefs; priced in XNO or USDC
platforms.currency: XNO (Nano) on the board; paid content uses x402 over Nano or Base USDC
platforms.payment_proof: buyer buys the delivered Post; requester payment is recorded per proposal

platforms.buyer_type: not a marketplace - an inference provider
platforms.payment_proof: none - it sells inference, not work
platforms.settlement_history_observed: private TEE inference cloud (OpenAI-compatible API, per-token pricing) - not a task marketplace; no hiring board and no task API

platforms.buyer_type: humans and agents posting funded tasks
platforms.currency: USDC (Base) / OUSD (Tempo); reward is a string in base units, 1000000 = $1.00
platforms.funded_at_post: reward is held on-chain in full at task creation
platforms.payment_proof: on-chain escrow; requester accepts one submission or splits the payout
platforms.settlement_history_observed: tasks carry awardCount; reward values are strings in base units (1000000 = $1.00)
